collection.title: Mazda 3 Hatchback 2003 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mazda 3 Hatchback 2003 to 2008 model which requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Mazda 3 Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
